verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party Connected Apps docs say it can connect to other apps to give more helpful responses: it can summarize Gmail emails, create Google Calendar events, and search content across productivity apps. Deep Research can also use personal Gmail and Drive as sources. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of searching or reading Calendar data (not just creating events) and of Drive search in regular chat outside Deep Research, plus independent or hands-on corroboration; Connected Apps also don't work in Google Messages.
